source.why_this_clip: A pink flamingo stands on one leg in a fenced enclosure, seen from the side, and shifts its tucked head and body slightly while the camera settles on it. The clip has no detected cuts; from 0 to 1.25 s the bird is behind the fence mesh and from 1.25 to 2.0 s the camera pans fast, so 2.0 to 4.0 s is the longest stretch where the flamingo is large and unobstructed (it enters from the left edge at 2.0 s).
